facts.fact: 呕吐源头=龙空中「jumping」机动技能；与 Transporter 限距不同（几百英尺）
jump 规则：只能跳到看得到的地方+须知极限——跳太远心脏会爆
facts.anchor: You can only jump where you can see, and you have to know your limit.

facts.fact: passive access（意志即得：龙视/夜视/听力）vs active access（jump 须经 soul-link 直接取力，手按胸口 hum）
facts.anchor: You wish to see something in the distance? Your will alone grants you the ability

facts.fact: 首跳成功：她按胸口+注视落点+抬脚——成功瞬移，随后连跳十一次
facts.anchor: Inara disappeared, reappearing in an instant in the spot she’d been staring at.

facts.fact: 过载呕吐：连跳后胃部翻腾又吐一轮（身体不适应，正常反应）
facts.anchor: She felt her stomach drop, roll, do a zig-zag

facts.fact: 王子第一声笑：看她像兔子蹦跳没忍住 chuckle→guffaw
facts.anchor: Did you just laugh? I didn’t think you were capable of such an emotion.

facts.fact: 王子中指戒指细节：银套红宝石——他指胸口「 hum of power」教她定位链接
facts.anchor: His hand touched the centre of his chest.
